test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’.

Based on the above, how is R related to Q if ‘P × Q ÷ T + S – R × V’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

Given: P × Q ÷ T + S – R × V

P × Q → P is the wife of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c25209f80dfef71db53c6970d46c0bf546875cae75609c7cf9c8c02bc949976.png] 

Q ÷ T → Q is the father of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aaf33646b7e1612676199755614413ac701c701f421cdbfd80605393ff65b43d.png] 

T ÷ S → T is the father of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f9d90583285af07453e2a2ba88aded7c95e81ba71b7ff8f93c761a5ecdb1a9b.png] 

S – R → S is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d660c00f3cca75db9d0e702f5d564b4d511b8b7154ed13ea83ef577c788f999.png] 

R × V → R is the wife of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd135062a0e7bf30d73db9675be72abfaae583a9649974224b3bd8aed94737cd.png] 

Here, R is the granddaughter or daughter’s daughter of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
